nieuw.titel: Take substantial core units for objective scoring
nieuw.tekst: When playing with the matched-play secondaries, include core units with high unit strength. Give them scoring jobs even if they are not good at killing enemies.
nieuw.waarom: He says several objectives require substantial core units. A core unit that scores while surviving also avoids giving up its own points.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He notes that not every mission includes the same objectives.

nieuw.titel: Claim progressive objectives against a defensive gunline
nieuw.tekst: If the opponent deploys defensively near the back of the board, move onto the strategic locations and start scoring. Holding the two side objectives and your middle objective can put pressure on the opponent to come and fight you there.
nieuw.waarom: He points out that these objectives score each player's turn, so an early lead can accumulate while the opponent stays back.

nieuw.titel: Deploy widely for Field of Glory's distributed objectives
nieuw.tekst: In Upon the Field of Glory with Strategic Locations Four and the other secondaries, deploy to reach the side objectives as well as the middle. Use separate core units to cover scoring locations rather than relying on one central block.
nieuw.waarom: He says a single large block cannot hold the middle and both flanks. A corner castle cuts itself off from portions of the board that offer points.

nieuw.titel: Concentrate centrally in King of the Hill
nieuw.tekst: In King of the Hill with a special feature on the hill, focus your force on the centre. He sees this as a mission for a central fight.
nieuw.waarom: He says the hill and special feature together make the centre especially valuable, with fewer other scoring opportunities than in Upon the Field of Glory.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He warns that the special feature is impassable and that the hill obstructs sight, making charges and shooting difficult.

nieuw.titel: Consider defensive shooting in Close Quarter
nieuw.tekst: In Close Quarter, a shooting army can sit on its own strategic location and shoot the opponent. He considers a more defensive approach workable here because the mission does not force you towards the flanks or a central terrain objective.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He says a similarly passive shooting list misses many points in other missions. Even here, Domination requires planning moves into table quarters later.

nieuw.titel: Delay commitment in A Chance Encounter
nieuw.tekst: In A Chance Encounter, you can wait, shoot at long range or work around a flank before committing. Plan to claim the central special feature and table quarters at the end.
nieuw.waarom: He says this mission lacks progressive strategic-location scoring, so there is no need to engage early to collect those points.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He stresses that the endgame objectives still need attention.
